name: URC Match Night Asset Pack
notes: One primary home venue per URC club. Includes the previously generated Stormers image. Current-season home-kit references except Lions, where only the 2025/26 design could be verified. Scenes are imagined matches, not documentary photographs.

assets.alt: Rainy nighttime rugby at Stadio Monigo, Treviso, with Benetton Rugby players in the background and wet turf in the foreground.
assets.kitReference: 2026/27 Errea HOME: white jersey crossed across the chest by irregular green brushstroke bands rather than perfectly regular hoops, green details, Errea double-diamond chest mark, white shorts and green/white socks.
assets.notes: AI-generated interpretation. Fine kit, sponsor and architectural details are approximate.
